game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
game.summary: Ground-up modern reconstruction of Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 featuring free camera control, manual jump (X) and dash (hold A), third-person over-the-shoulder aiming with gyro, microphone Ocarina input, 5 Empty Bottles, rebalanced 200/500/1000-Rupee Wallets, Great Fairy Rupee offerings, the Echo Gem replacing the Stone of Agony, 3 relocated cross-era/Scrub Heart Pieces, shifted Gold Skulltulas with daytime faint web cues, Zora's Domain unfreezing after the Water Temple, the Threads of Time quest log, the Hall of Fallen Foes (84 enemy/boss statues & boss rush), and Zelda Notes companion integration.

gateTiers.label: Grab Right Now (No Gear / First Visit)
gateTiers.description: Collectibles and secrets accessible immediately upon reaching the area in its native era without special dungeon items or songs.

gateTiers.label: Time, Rupees & Bottle Utility
gateTiers.description: Locked only behind Nighttime, Rupees/Wallet capacity, or releasing Bottled Bugs into Soft Soil patches.

gateTiers.label: Ocarina Melody Gates
gateTiers.description: Requires playing one or more specific Ocarina melodies (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, Sun's Song, Song of Storms, Warp Songs, or Scarecrow's Song).

gateTiers.label: Child Dungeon & Sidequest Gear
gateTiers.description: Locked behind Child-era progression tools: Slingshot, Bombs, Boomerang, Silver Scale, Magic Meter/Din's Fire, Lens of Truth, or Happy Masks.

gateTiers.label: Cross-Era Time-Travel Puzzles (Child <-> Adult)
gateTiers.description: Requires preparation in one era and payoff in the other: Magic Bean platforms, Song of Storms Windmill, and Switch 2 'Fairy's Thoughts' cross-era puzzles.

gateTiers.label: Adult Dungeon Gear & Endgame
gateTiers.description: Locked behind Adult Link progression: Epona, Hookshot/Longshot, Bow, Megaton Hammer, Iron/Hover Boots, Tunics, Golden Scale, Silver/Golden Gauntlets.

switch2Controls.jump: X Button (Dedicated manual jump added in Switch 2 Remake)
switch2Controls.camera: Right Stick (Free 360° camera) + ZL Lock-On / Recenter
switch2Controls.aiming: Over-the-shoulder 3rd-person reticle + optional Joy-Con 2 / Pro Controller Gyro
switch2Controls.questLog: Minus (-) Button -> Threads of Time & Tapestry View (Y)

ocarinaNotes.microphone: Optional Switch 2 built-in microphone humming/whistling or real instrument pitch detection
